clusters.name: member-crash-autonotify
clusters.executionModeRationale: All six stories mutate a small shared set of crews files (envelope.js, stop.js, health.js, listener-loop.js, the new helper, and the 6 version stamps) with hard ordering dependencies: the member-crashed kind must be registered before the sweep appends it, the helper must exist before D-001/D-003 call it, and the version bump must land last. There is no disjoint surface to parallelize; parallel clusters would conflict on envelope.js/stop.js and the version files. Run serially in one impl member.
